      cool ai stuff !

      A curated collection of AI APIs and websites offering free usage of AI models under g4f principles

      📊 View our interactive dashboard for a better visual overview!

      ⚠️ Disclaimer

      I, @zukixa, am the queen of zukijourney, but I am also the only one to actively maintain this list.

      We are not endorsing any of the listed services! Some of them might be considered controversial. We are not responsible for any legal, technical or any other damage caused by using the listed services. Data is provided without warranty of any kind. Use these at your own risk!

      📋 Inclusion Criteria

      To be added to this list, your API must:

      • Have a clean record
      • Serve 100+ members
      • Provide stable service
      • Support at least chat & image generation functionalities in the OpenAI format
      • Example API implementation here

      🏆 API Tiers Overview

      Tier 1 — Established, Premium-Service AI API Leaders
      Service Users NSFW/RP Open Source Owner(s) Models Notes
      zukijourney 8,058 ✅ Allowed ✅ Repo ZJ Team Models The undisputed leader of the AI APIs, the largest & oldest of its kind still running. Offers other popular AI-related bots too.
      ElectronHub 5,898 ✅ Use /nsfw/ ❌ snowby666 Models Developed by the ex-maintainer of the poe-api-wrapper. Very RP-friendly.
      VoidAI 2,089 💰 Paid only ❌ acatto Models An odd api with historically some other ai-related projects. Now focused on just APIs it seems.
      Tier 2 — Standard, Basic AI API Services
      Service Users NSFW/RP Open Source Owner(s) Models Notes
      NagaAI 3,582 ❌ Forbidden ❌ ZentixUA Models Honorary successor to ChimeraGPT, the largest g4f API in history (16k users).
      HelixMind 2,651 ❌ Forbidden ❌ faer1x Models Subscription-based service that 'just about' fits into the g4f principles definition with its free tier, with some oddity
      ZanityAI 1,690 💰 Paid only ❌ Voidii Models solid service that has been long-running and focused on providing a rp experience.
      Tier 3 — 'Inconsistent' APIs
      Service Users NSFW/RP Open Source Owner(s) Models Notes
      Kimetsu 2,014 ❌ Forbidden ❌ ichatei Models Place has some lore.
      NavyAPI 1,543 ✅ Allowed ❌ draycast Models Small API with solid service - previously in controversy
      MNN 479 ✅ Limited ❌ MNN Models Long-term standing small AI API with some useful models.
      Tier 4 — Experimental, Unstable, Open-Access APIs
      Service Users NSFW/RP Open Source Owner(s) Models Notes
      WebraftAI 1,506 ❌ Forbidden ❌ ds_gamer Models Recovered from 5-month downtime due to the owner's health issues. Some instability in current service.
      VoltAI 249 ✅ Allowed ❌ Zlnce Models API ran by a 'crackhead' (figuratively) who everyone thought went to prison.
      hcap.ai 219 ✅ Allowed ❌ mehhovcki Models Small API with new developers to the space. Some creativity.
      Tier 5 — Caution Advised! Questionable AI API Offerings
      Service Users NSFW/RP Open Source Owner(s) Models Why Potentially Misleading?
      NexeonAI 409 ❌ Forbidden ❌ Sakuya Models Owner has been regularly DDOSing competition very openly and publicly. He is the local federal agent.
      Non-Tiered — Non-API AI Servers
      Service Users What does it provide? Other Notes
      g4f.ai 12,324 Hub of the github repository that started it all. Not very active, nor really moderated.
      FreeGPT4 4,823 Ancient community of gpt-4-free individuals. Plenty good AI-related content. Ran by @lomusire
      SpyrkAI 623 AI Labs founded by (some) ex-community members; aims to create a free & OSS alt. to OpenAI, leveraging growing interest in AI APIs. Currently a slightly inactive server, but some behind-the-scenes work continues.
      OpenShapes 212 Project server for 'open source character-ai-like discord bots' - the OpenShapes platform. Still a WIP - project wise. Selfhost option works!
      serika.dev 74 Project server for 'open source character-ai-like website characters' - the serika.dev platform Ran by a friend of the ZJ team.
      Webscout N/A All-in-one Python toolkit for web search, AI interaction, and digital utilities. Unified access to 90+ AI providers (OpenAI, Gemini, Meta, Perplexity, local LLMs), multiple search engines, and developer/media/privacy tools. CLI & OpenAI-compatible API server, supports local LLMs via Inferno, and offers utilities for YouTube, TTS, TTI, temp email/phone, weather, GitHub data, web scraping, and more. Easy install (pip/UV/Docker), highly extensible, well-documented, and developer-friendly. Contributions welcome!
